column1: # No. 1, 28 July 1783 (s001; s002 has no cipher). Partial gloss in another hand above line 1 ("de vous mander que je suis ... le moindre accident"), and "facheux accident territoire prussien" at the foot.
# clear: hormis que je me porte un peu mal, mais j'espaire que ce n'aurat point de suite. Cette ville est ramplie

# notes (5x pass, n5_L3*): after monsieur: l a n g s o n a u, divider dot, m e u r, then du courrier (d u c o u r r i e r, inverted-T as d then o), du b... ; NEW5 = blotted sign over a figure-7 stroke before s r h at the line end; G19 open C read g but the word is unclear (a name? or l'an(c)... son humeur?)

# 6x pass 26 Oct 2026: signs before 500 re-read; NEW1 (small square box) = y in "il y en a"; the sign after "Hollandois" is overwritten by later figures (read e, entre); a vertical stroke from the overwriting hand crosses after "lesquel" (no sign read there); "patriotes" with inverted-T as o

# line 3 reading: (clear: Cette ville est ramplie de Holl-)andois entre lesquel il y en a des foux (faux) patriotes :: 500 parler monsieur langson(?) aumeur (son humeur? cf. l'aumeur = l'humeur, line 6) du courrier du b ? (s) r h ... (runs on to line 4)
# NEW1 = small square box sign, line 3
# lines 4-20 (cipher runs between clear text down to the signature "8a9g..." and "le 28 Juillet 1783 No. 1"): NOT transcribed in this pass

# reading: 500 [j'ai] l'honneur de vous mander que je suis arriver hier san(s) le moindre accidant facheu(x) ... le territoire prussiens hormis que je me porte un peu mal ... Cette ville est ramplie de Hollandais ... 500 parler monsieur ...
# --- second pass at 3x-6x (lines 4 on); uncertain signs read '?' ---

# notes: 5x pass (n5_L4*): line opens under an interlinear gloss with corrected/overwritten signs; signs 7-9 three looped signs (i or l, unclear); NEW2 = crossed f-like sign with dot below, read as G22 x (teriteaux); 'pour' written as a dash then inverted-T o u r (the dash read as a divider, not b); after pour: c u e d e m r e r l n a n t (tail unclear: 'que demeurer'? '[v]enant'?); donnet une, bien, Amsterdam secure

# 6x pass 26 Oct 2026: signs 7-9 are i, arch (a), i: "lui ai"; after "diet" an inverted-T, a sign hidden under the overwriting hand's figure (NEW7, read e from context), then d o nn e t; "louenge" = l + inverted-T as o + u e n + open C (G19 g) + e (earlier "l-duence"); "bien merite" with the small L (m); the dash before o u r is G24 b: bourguemetre; "~ e ~ e C" read r e r e g (earlier "rerl"): regnant d'Amsterdam
# line 4 reading: (line 3 runs on) ...inet lui ai diet (dit) d[e] donnet (donner) une louenge (louange) bien merite aux bourguemetre(s) regnant d'Amsterdam :: (clear: Je sui arriver a tems)
# notes: 'viennent' written v i e nn e t; 't?pois' blotted (ink blot over sign 2)
# line reading: (clear: pour l'empecher de faire le contraire,) car le parti du duc avoit ?-pois donner le bien qu'il viennent de faire ::  (clear: Il est)
# notes: NEW3 = sign under an ink blot before 'ontre', read c from context; signs 4-6 unclear; '::' after 'parle' not written as a token; in 'Thulemeier' the 6th sign read m

# 6x pass 26 Oct 2026: signs 3-6 are the T with the curling descender (G10 v), e, u, large L (t): "ce veut dire"; no extra e before dire; the sign in "l-umeur" is the arch G09 (a), not h: the writer spells humeur "aumeur" (also line 3)
# line 6 reading: (clear: Il est furieusement emporter) ce veut dire (cela veut dire) l'aumeur (l'humeur) dont il me parle :: contre monsieur Thulemeier (clear: il ne lui donne point de pardon)
# line reading: (clear: de pardon; m'ai je lui ai dit de rester tranquile a ce sujet, et d'etre bien precautioneux pour qu'elque tems) de peur qu'il
# notes: cup sign G11 reads g in agens/regardant (cf. 'se meler' note in signs_alphabet: G11 not only c); middle stretch after 'intentionnes' uncertain; last word perhaps 'ciel' or a slip for 'duc'
# line reading: (qu'il) ne manque des agens bien intentionnes qu? demeres(?) tres g(u)arde(?) regardant le parti du c?el ::  (clear: Je sui assure qu'il)

# notes: 5x pass (n5_L9*): NEW4 = heavy forked upright with long left descender = s (same as G21, the second s sign): il soupsonna (soupconna). Inverted-T read o in soupsonna/monsieur/votre, d in d'etre/du/de. 'general' has the open C G19 = g. 'du cal' (cup + arch + crossed loop) recurs at the end of line 8; unexplained, perhaps a slip or abbreviation (cabale?)
# line reading: (clear: n'y manquera pas.) il soupsonna monsieur votre frere le general d'etre du parti du cal(?) : 499 de le desabuser

# notes: 5x pass (n5_L12*): sign 5 is the T with a descender curling left = G10 v (as in 'votre' line 9), not q; sign 8 is a figure-7 with a dot above (ss by the dot rule) but 'vous ss anur' gives no clear word; 'dent son' = dans son (sound-spelling); last word p r o j a i t = projet (cf. donnet for donnait); represente, dent son projait secure
# line reading: (clear: force de dire la verite a son sujet.) mais vous ?(ss)anur(?) represente dent son projait (dans son projet) :: (clear: il a le feux militaire, je croi de)

# notes: 5x pass (n5_L13*): first word is a v e n t (avant, sound-spelled), not avec; G14 q then u o nn = qu'on n(e); NEW3 = ink blot, read e from context; dotted L = tt (soi[t] tout); the sign after 'a' in 'a fai' is the short T with stem = G04 f (earlier read h); the dash before 'onne' is G24 b (bonne); dotted figure-7 = ss in reussi (same sign as line 12 sign 8)
# line reading: (clear: ... ne faut point etre mis en usage) avent qu'onn[e] soit tout a fai(t) sur de la bonne reussi- (line 14: -te ::)
# notes: NEW3 = blotted sign at line start; 'Frederic' first sign drawn as the T-with-curl (read f, v elsewhere); 'sans' written with the e-sign; 'precaution' garbled (c u a c e t t i o n)
# line reading: (line 13 ends) ...te :: ?us du mien du grand Frederic et par la des vrais bons intentionnes :: sans cete precaution ... te d(e)usser ... (runs on)

# notes: 5x pass (n5_L15*): after 475: s e r e n ? i ss i m [blot] = serenissime (sign 5 after s e r e n is an extra inverted-T, unclear); then a lone L-sign (t? et?) before la malheureuse; after 801: c e t i d i e (cet idee, sound-spelled), s u i a + small dotted cup + i v e r a (s'y a(cc)ivera? unclear); hash sign = G20 z: z e l e (zele, dotted l); NEW6 = squared bracket open to the LEFT without middle bar (mirror of G08), before 'e zele', read v from context (a ve zele = avec zele); ink blot = NEW3; 880 and 475 code readings unchanged

# 6x pass 26 Oct 2026: second L at line start is the small L (m): "t mal"; sign 3 after s e r e n is the looped G17 (i), not an inverted T: serenissime (one i before the dotted s; the earlier pass counted it twice); the L after the blot is the large L (t); the dotted sign before i v e r a is the wave with a dot (rr), not a cup: arrivera; only one arch before NEW6 (the second a was a double count)

# line 15 reading: (line 14 runs on) ...verion t mal 880 . 475 : serenissime [e]t la malheureuse 801 . cet idie (cette idee) sui a(r)rivera ?e zele (avec zele?) :: (clear: ma maladie est un peu plus forte)
# line 16 (s001 line near foot: 'force de prendre recours a')
# notes: 'caisse' with dotted s (ss); after 403 weakly read, perhaps '... prejudice'
# line reading: (clear: forcer de prendre recours) a la caisse du 403 . du ? den ?reudice(?) ... :: (clear: ce qui auroit put faire un mauvais effait)
# signature (last line, before 'le 28 Juillet 1783. No. 1'): digit/symbol run read as 8a97 H 3 0 9 6 0 5 3 3 4 + 5 9 6 3 8 7 9 9 a, not transcribed as tokens, not read (as in No. 2)
